package domain

import "time"

const HybridConsequenceSchema = "planner-hybrid-consequence.v1"
const HybridOutcomeNoChange = "NO_CHANGE"
const HybridOutcomeReplanNeeded = "REPLAN_NEEDED"
const HybridApplicationAuto = "AUTO"
const HybridApplicationRequiresIntent = "REQUIRES_INTENT"

type HybridScopeIdentity struct {
	GoalCode      string   `json:"goal_code"`
	DirectionCode string   `json:"direction_code"`
	DesiredStacks []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
}

type HybridFutureMutation struct {
	Kind           string `json:"kind"`
	ItemID         string `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	TargetPosition *int   `json:"target_position,omitempty"`
	TemplateItemID string `json:"template_learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
	NewItemID      string `json:"new_learning_path_item_id,omitempty"`
}

type HybridRequestedChange struct {
	Scope     HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"scope"`
	Mutations []HybridFutureMutation `json:"mutations"`
}

type HybridLearningIntentProjection struct {
	IntentID             string                `json:"intent_id"`
	StudentID            string                `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string                `json:"learning_path_id"`
	ExpectedPathRevision int64                 `json:"expected_path_revision"`
	Kind                 string                `json:"kind"`
	RequestedChange      HybridRequestedChange `json:"requested_change"`
	CreatedAt            time.Time             `json:"created_at"`
}

type HybridPrerequisiteTarget struct {
	Ref           HybridTargetRef   `json:"ref"`
	Prerequisites []HybridTargetRef `json:"prerequisites"`
}

type HybridPrerequisiteGraph struct {
	Available    bool                       `json:"available"`
	GoalCode     string                     `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalVersion  string                     `json:"goal_version,omitempty"`
	GraphVersion string                     `json:"graph_version,omitempty"`
	Targets      []HybridPrerequisiteTarget `json:"targets"`
}

type HybridConsequenceInputs struct {
	Policy    PolicyBundle            `json:"policy"`
	Graph     HybridPrerequisiteGraph `json:"graph"`
	InputHash string                  `json:"input_hash"`
}

type HybridConsequence struct {
	Schema               string                 `json:"schema"`
	ConsequenceID        string                 `json:"consequence_id"`
	StudentID            string                 `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID       string                 `json:"learning_path_id"`
	ExpectedPathRevision int64                  `json:"expected_path_revision"`
	SnapshotRef          string                 `json:"snapshot_ref"`
	SnapshotTargets      []HybridTargetRef      `json:"snapshot_targets"`
	PolicyVersion        string                 `json:"policy_version"`
	PolicyInputHash      string                 `json:"policy_input_hash"`
	Outcome              string                 `json:"outcome"`
	ApplicationMode      string                 `json:"application_mode,omitempty"`
	ReasonCodes          []string               `json:"reason_codes"`
	BaselineScope        HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"baseline_scope"`
	DesiredScope         HybridScopeIdentity    `json:"desired_scope"`
	Mutations            []HybridFutureMutation `json:"mutations"`
	IntentID             string                 `json:"intent_id,omitempty"`
	RequiredIntentKind   string                 `json:"required_intent_kind,omitempty"`
}

type HybridConsequenceEvaluation struct {
	Job        HybridEvaluationJob
	ClaimToken string
	LeaseUntil time.Time
	Inputs     *HybridConsequenceInputs
}

type HybridConsequenceReceipt struct {
	JobID       string            `json:"job_id"`
	PayloadHash string            `json:"payload_hash"`
	Consequence HybridConsequence `json:"consequence"`
	CommittedAt time.Time         `json:"committed_at"`
}
